meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会新增一个 Signal 频道。它通过 signal-cli 把 Claude 作为辅助设备链接到你已有的 Signal 电话号码,之后就能用该号码收发消息,跟你对话。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Signal 频道、链接 Signal 账号,或需要扫描二维码绑定设备时,该技能会接管设置流程。

say.text: 帮我接入 Signal 频道
say.note: 开始安装 signal-cli 并复制适配器。

say.text: 把我链接到 Signal 账号
say.note: 运行 device-link,打印二维码供扫描。

say.text: 设置 Signal 集成并扫码绑定
say.note: 进入链接步骤,扫码后完成关联。

howto.what_en: Enables a Signal channel in NanoClaw. It links Claude as a secondary device to an existing Signal phone number via signal-cli, then sends/receives messages as that number.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Signal channel, link a Signal account, or scan a QR code to bind a device.

say_en.text: Set up a Signal channel for me.
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and copies the adapter.

say_en.text: Link me to my Signal account.
say_en.note: Runs device-link and prints a QR to scan.

say_en.text: Add Signal integration and scan to bind.
say_en.note: Walks through the link step to associate the account.
